title: Who Are You
studio_context: Ramport, Olympic and RAK, September 1977 to April 1978; released 18 August 1978, under a month before his death. Apart from the title track, his drums were recorded in the last two weeks at Ramport.

drum_performances.name: Keith Moon
drum_performances.why_it_matters: His last album, made when his playing had 'noticeably deteriorated': the title track's half-time verse, the snare on 3 alone, a china now and then.
